thesis: The episode argues that American Tower is an all-weather asset characterized by disciplined management that balances growth with dividend maintenance. The speaker highlights the company's ability to expand free cash flow margins through operating leverage and a business mix shift toward data centers, distinguishing it from competitors facing negative billings growth.
